architecture: Ascend A2/A3 DAV-2201; exact runtime SoC

skill_template.adaptation: Direct Vector kernel with TPipe-local buffers and torch dispatch; replaced add with per-block quantization and explicit synchronization. No DAV-3510 MicroAPI templates used.

contract: Per batch/head/128 tokens absmax FP32, scale=max(abs(x))/127 clamped to FP32 tiny, scale=1 for all zero, FP32 Div then INT32 RNE and exact narrowing. Pad D128 and S256 with exact zeros. No native FP8.
